## File: facebookresearch_esm/examples/variant-prediction/predict.py

Prompts

```
['run ESM model predictions on a deep mutational scan CSV file to label mutations with scores', 'run an MSA Transformer model on a deep mutational scan using masked marginals scoring strategy', 'run pseudo perplexity scoring on each mutation variant in a deep mutational scan dataset', 'create an argparse parser for ESM variant prediction with model, sequence, and scoring strategy options', 'label a single mutation row by computing the log probability difference between mutant and wildtype tokens']
```

Usage

```
{'run_variant_prediction': 'run ESM model predictions on a deep mutational scan CSV file to label mutations with scores', 'run_msa_transformer_prediction': 'run an MSA Transformer model on a deep mutational scan using masked marginals scoring strategy', 'run_pseudo_ppl_scoring': 'run pseudo perplexity scoring on each mutation variant in a deep mutational scan dataset', 'create_parser_esm_variant': 'create an argparse parser for ESM variant prediction with model, sequence, and scoring strategy options', 'label_mutation_row': 'label a single mutation row by computing the log probability difference between mutant and wildtype tokens'}
```
